answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 20253 Country: India Title: i wanna ask that if 3 talaq has been given , and in process of halalah what is the minimum limit of sohabat with second husband? Question: assalmualay kum mufti sahab, i wanna ask that if 3 talaq has been given , and in process of halalah what is the minimum limit of sohabat with second husband? Answer ID: 20253 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 408/314/D=1431) As per hadith of Usailah, at least one time intercourse (penetration of penis in vagina) is compulsory. There is no limit for the period of muashirah : الطلاق لمن أخذ الساق ۔۔۔ و الذي بيده عقدة النكاح Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
